newsitem.title: USA: NY providing toll-free energy information.
newsitem.headline: NY providing toll-free energy information.

text.p: The New York Public Service Commission Wednesday reminded consumers that toll-free access to information on the emerging competitive natural gas and electric utility industries is available by calling 1-888-ASK-PSC1.

Commission Chairman John F. O'Mara said "The purpose of our Informed Energy Choices line is to keep consumers up-to-date on these changing industries and to provide them with enough information to make informed decisions."
1-888-ASK-PSC1 (1-888-275-7721) connects the in-state caller to an automated phone system of recorded messages on natural gas and electric competition, the commission said.

The toll-free line allows consumers access to answers to commonly asked questions regarding the Commission's plan to establish a wholesale competitive electric market in 1997 and the introduction of retail competition in 1998. Consumers can leave their name and address to receive mailed information regarding restructuring plans, commission brochures and a list of natural gas suppliers operating within the state.
The toll-free number also informs callers on how to express their opinion on the restructuring of the electric and natural gas industries, and other regulatory issues.
